title: Galaxy S25 and S24 Ultra users report overheating after Samsung's July update
desc: Some owners of Samsung's Galaxy S25 Ultra and Galaxy S24 Ultra smartphones have reported overheating, unusually fast battery drain and slower charging speeds after installing the company's July software update, according to media reports and user posts on online forums.

title: Xbox's revenue fell by $1.7 billion, whilst console sales dropped by 29%
desc: Microsoft's gaming division ended the 2026 financial year with a $1.7 billion, or 7 per cent, decline in revenue. Sales of Xbox consoles fell most sharply, whilst the increase in revenue from XBOX Game Pass was only able to partially offset the losses in other areas.

title: What is the best squat tempo for strength and power?
desc: Squat training with a 2-second lowering phase boosts muscle strength and explosive abilities, according to recent findings from Shandong Sport University.

title: Study links dietary fructose to aggressive spread of ovarian cancer
desc: A new study from The Wistar Institute has uncovered an unexpected link between fructose - a common dietary sugar - and the spread of an aggressive form of ovarian cancer.
